scope: Canon films and the named released Clone Wars, Rebels and Ahsoka scenes. No Legends lore or unreleased answers. Mysteries means explained evidence and remaining interpretive questions, not claimed secret revelations.
method: Opened public plot references, official production/Databank sources and creator/cast interviews; primary fictional works are episode/book locators. Original commentary; no copied dialogue. Not a claim to have watched every episode or newly read each whole novel.

sources.fact: The Force is created by living things; the films show perception, influence and agency without giving an exhaustive scientific account.
sources.work: A New Hope; The Empire Strikes Back; The Phantom Menace

sources.fact: Midichlorians are the symbiotic means of communication with the Force in Qui-Gon's explanation; potential and training remain different questions.
sources.work: The Phantom Menace; Ahsoka Part Three

sources.fact: Mortis presents Father, Son and Daughter; the Son shows Anakin his future and the Father removes that memory.
The Dagobah cave presents Yoda and Luke with visions; Luke sees his face under Vader's mask.
sources.work: The Empire Strikes Back; The Clone Wars Voices

sources.fact: Yoda follows Qui-Gon's voice and undergoes trials; persistence after death is a learned practice rather than simple physical survival.
The World Between Worlds has pathways between time and space; Ezra saves Ahsoka and does not save Kanan.
Rey and Ben share a dyad; healing, object transfer and Ben's final sacrifice are shown, without a universal rulebook.
Purrgil travel through hyperspace naturally; Ezra's relationship with living creatures matters to the liberation of Lothal.
sources.work: Rebels The Call and Family Reunion and Farewell

forbidden: Equal numbers of Jedi and Sith as the definition of balance
Palpatine or Plagueis confirmed to have created Anakin
Abeloth, the Ones' origin, the Whills or Grey Jedi doctrine treated as canon answers
World Between Worlds as a proven unlimited time-rewrite machine
Force ghosts as a common automatic outcome for all dead Jedi
Sabine proves everyone has identical potential
Future Ahsoka seasons or game-only scenes
